subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) The Titanic sank (i) before the ship stuck violently against an ice-berg. (b) There were (ii) when she was sailing across the north Atlantic (c) An alarm was (iii) no passenger in the ship given when it sank (d) The Titanic had an (iv) that had been ever built accident (e) The Titanic was the (v) with heavy loss of life. biggest ship (vi) 891 crew on the Titanic. First Paper  Questions (vii) without any loss
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) The Titanic sank when she was sailing across the north Atlantic. (b) + (vi) There were 891 crew on the Titanic. (c) + (i) An alarm was given before the ship struck violently against an ice-berg. (d) + (v) The Titanic had an accident with heavy loss of life. (e) + (iv) The Titanic was the biggest ship that had been ever built.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 87 — Matripith Govt. Girls' High School, Chandpur
